name: Systematic Delivery
description: Turns a software request into a verified sequence of design, plan, implementation, review and completion.
constraints: Do not expand the requested scope while formalizing the workflow.
Evidence from the repository and executed checks takes precedence over confident model claims.
Never declare completion while a known failing acceptance check remains.
guidance: Convert the requested outcome into observable acceptance checks before substantial implementation.
Inspect the existing behavior and run the narrowest useful baseline check before editing.
Implement in small coherent deltas and verify each risky boundary before proceeding.
Review the result against the request, architecture constraints and likely failure modes.
Finish only with evidence from the final artifact and rerun checks after repairs.
completion_checks: Acceptance checks cover the original requested outcome.
The final implementation was tested after the last modification.
No known failure or scope omission is hidden by a partial success.
The handoff names the result, evidence and any genuinely unverified external dependency.
